question: What immense wealth and destructive power against enemies characterize this deity?
premises: The deity possesses wealth equal to crores of Kuberas.
The deity destroys crores of enemies.
inference: The deity commands boundless wealth and overwhelming power to destroy enemies.
uncertainties: chatrukoṭivināśanaḥ appears to be an orthographic variant of śatrukoṭivināśanaḥ.
plain_english: He possesses the wealth of crores of Kuberas and is the destroyer of crores of enemies.
